title: An afternoon at the IDX plaza
method: Built-in image_gen generation and five image_gen revisions, then proportional resizing and WebP encoding. No cropping or semantic retouching after generation.
caption: A relaxed afternoon in a landscaped Jakarta plaza inspired by the IDX twin towers, with pedestrians, a cyclist and a coffee cart. Conceptual editorial artwork, not a documentary view or a measurement of market conditions.
typography: The website supplies the exact catalogue title, date, issue number and Longhand signature. The generated artwork contains no lettering. The upper third is reserved for live typesetting.
ownerRevision: The owner's 25 October 2026 chat revisions supersede the original PR #114 brief: ordinary passers-by instead of rope holders, then no bull at all; a landscaped IDX plaza with an attractive sky and fewer people walking, cycling or buying snacks; further polish of the drawing and small details; and more varied clothing colours, faces, adult ages and natural Indonesian skin tones. The final artwork follows these revisions.

promptHistory.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a new finished 2:3 portrait editorial cover illustration, exactly 1024 x 1536, full bleed, artwork only for Longhand Research. Concept: a giant friendly inflatable bull parade balloon rising above the plaza of the Indonesia Stock Exchange twin towers in SCBD Jakarta, steadied by ordinary local people holding its ropes, as travellers leave. This is conceptual satire, not a documentary event.
Style reference: the September cover seen in the conversation guides only the visual language: careful clean black ligne-claire ink contours, mid-century editorial comic, controlled crosshatching and restrained halftone, flat print colours on subtle warm paper grain. Use its human specificity and hand-drawn care, but make this scene bright daylight, optimistic, witty and lively. No photorealism, glossy 3D or vector-icon look.
Composition: portrait magazine cover with an uncluttered pale warm blue/cream sky in the top third for a long typeset headline added later. Place the bull just below that headline zone around the upper middle, above the crowd, with a strong readable silhouette. It is a warm ochre/vermilion inflated fabric balloon: seams, gently rounded torso, exactly four small legs, two short horns, two ears, one tail, friendly calm face. Ropes attach naturally to its underside and descend visibly into the holders' hands. One distant small passenger jet climbs away near the side of the sky, subordinate to the bull and outside the central headline area.
Backdrop: recognisable paired IDX towers, blue-gray glass curtain-wall blocks with chamfered corners, close horizontal window bands and stepped angular crowns, behind the plaza. Their tops stay below the quiet headline zone. No building lettering or logos. Rain trees, kerb, low bench, potted plants and sunlit stone paving.
Foreground: a lively but legible small crowd, about nine distinct Jakarta people in natural comfortable stances, with enough spacing to see each body and rope. Office workers with blank lanyards, a woman in a hijab, two students in white and gray school uniforms, an ojek rider in a plain green jacket, and a street coffee seller helping with the ropes after leaving his bicycle coffee cart nearby. Most face sideways or three-quarter toward the bull. Each visible face is individually drawn, each hand has ordinary human anatomy and a convincing grip, each person has exactly two arms and two legs. Ropes are continuous simple lines ending in hands, not intersecting bodies. Avoid crowded overlapping hands.
At one edge in the middle distance, two travellers pull ordinary wheeled suitcases toward a waiting plain taxi, walking away from the balloon without looking back. These are conceptual travellers, no flags or nationality labels. Crowded Jakarta life, believable perspective, careful vehicles. Bottom edge is simple sunlit paving with room for a small signature added later.
Palette: bright cream and pale sky, muted teal and mineral navy building detail, warm ochre bull, restrained rust accents and tropical greens, warm afternoon sun with soft clear shadows, no night or dramatic dark atmosphere.
Hard limits: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs with writing, logos, watermark, currency symbols, financial charts, ticker figures, arrows, speech balloons, masks or superhero motifs. No actual animal bull, no aggressive expression. Nothing cut off awkwardly. Deliver a complete polished illustration with especially careful faces, hands, ropes and suitcase wheels.

Revise this cover illustration with one composition correction: reserve the complete upper third (top 0–480 pixels of a 1024 x 1536 portrait) as quiet pale warm blue sky with only subtle paper grain, entirely empty of bull, plane, towers, clouds or ropes so a long live typeset headline will fit. All narrative elements must sit below this headline zone. Reduce and lower the bull slightly so both horn tips are below y=500; its full silhouette should occupy approximately y=500–960. Place the small departing jet at the far right below y=500 too. Compress the architectural background and plaza scene into the lower two thirds while preserving readable crowd faces and hands. Preserve the existing bright careful ink-and-print illustration style, warm ochre/vermilion friendly inflatable bull, two blue-gray stepped IDX twin towers, Jakarta crowd naturally holding continuous ropes, coffee bicycle cart, ojek rider, hijab woman, white-and-gray uniformed students, and departing travellers with suitcases going toward a taxi. Keep bottom paving quiet for the signature. Exactly 1024x1536 portrait, no cropping, full bleed. Check all anatomy: every person two arms and two legs, natural hands gripping the rope, bull four legs two horns two ears one tail. No text, letters, numbers, logos, charts or currency symbols. Avoid glossy 3D, nighttime and photorealism. This is conceptual editorial illustration, not a factual event photograph.

Natural anatomy, individually drawn faces, normal hands, correct bicycle wheels and pedals, no overlapping limbs. Keep a quiet strip of paving at the bottom for the website's signature.

promptHistory.stage: Owner polish: print texture and human, bicycle and cart detail
promptHistory.prompt:
Polish this exact cover illustration, preserving its portrait composition, IDX twin towers, garden plaza, quiet sky space at top, and relaxed number of people. The owner likes the concept but wants less generic AI polish, more thoughtful human illustration, and much more careful small details.
ART DIRECTION: make it feel drawn by a skilled editorial artist with pen, brush and a limited print palette on lightly textured paper, rather than a pristine digital cartoon. Subtle varied hand-inked line weight, selective fine hatching, a few softly broken ink edges and restrained printed colour irregularity. Retain clean confident drawing; don't bury details in distressed noise. Softer mineral blue-gray glazing, restrained sage/olive greens, warm cream sunlit paving and gentle ochre accents. Reduce the over-saturated cyan sky and yellow-green foliage. Keep a luminous beautiful sky: natural soft blue with delicate well-observed cream-white clouds, mostly calm upper third for live headline. No sunset, no dark mood, no dramatic god rays, no airbrushed gloss or artificial glow. Slightly asymmetric trees and garden planting; naturally varied leaves and shadows, not repetitive ornamental blobs. Architectural lines are precise and convincing, with the IDX towers' stepped crowns and window grids drawn consistently in perspective; glass reflections restrained, not mirror-like.
HUMAN DETAIL: redraw the visible faces as distinct believable Indonesian adults with understated expressions, natural smaller eyes, nuanced noses and mouths, no anime faces, no identical smiles or cloned features. Keep existing gestures but make posture and anatomy carefully observed. Two arms and two legs per person. Hands must clearly hold cups, bag straps or handlebars with normal finger counts and believable joints, no fused fingers. Clothing should have specific realistic folds and seams, ordinary cotton shirt fabric, slightly lived-in trousers and shoes, modest unbranded everyday bags; no plastic smooth skin or glossy clothes. Foreground figures remain individually readable, background people more economical in pen detail rather than malformed miniature faces.
BICYCLE: draw a mechanically correct ordinary commuter bicycle with two round wheels in consistent perspective, clear spoke hubs, connected frame tubes, a believable crank and chain drive, pedals beneath feet, rider's hands naturally gripping the handlebar and two feet placed correctly, no duplicated tubes or limbs. Preserve one cyclist crossing at a relaxed pace.
COFFEE CART: clearly constructed modest mobile coffee cart beside its bicycle, with straight wood panels, rational wheels/axles and small neatly placed metal kettles and cups. No floating vessels or fused bicycle wheel/cart. Vendor and customer have normal hands and distinct bodies. Keep one person sitting on bench naturally with believable legs and an ordinary blank notebook or phone.
Overall an observant, warm, calm hand-drawn Jakarta street scene in the tradition of mid-century editorial reportage and a quality printed illustrated book. Keep it bright, clear, appealing at cover size. No added symbolic object. No bull, balloon, ropes or airplane. No text, letters, numbers, logos, signs with writing, charts, currency symbols or watermarks. Exactly 1024x1536 portrait, full bleed, preserve generous headline space and quiet lower paving.
